messages:
alex (CEO): Quick heads-up  All-hands this Monday 9:00am PT. Toplines: 1) brief strategy check-in; 2) Dedicated beta status; 3) new external-demo & security embargo process; 4) short incident review; 5) Q&A. Drop questions here or add to Notion: https://notion.redwood/company/all-hands-input. Recording posted after.

nina (CTO): We'll demo the security hardening for private deploys (2min). If infra owners want to call out any perf tradeoffs, add a 1-line note.

maya (VP Product): Launch owners: please paste a single-line status under "Launch Callouts" in Notion by Sun EOD. Marketing+Legal must approve any external-facing materials.

sasha (Security): New item: Security now requires a demo checklist for any demo that shows model outputs or customer data. Checklist link: https://security.redwood/demos/checklist. If in doubt, run it by me.

rachel (Legal): Legal + Marketing will triage demo approvals. For anything with customer data or partner logos, we need signed permission (NDA or written consent).

sam (People Ops): Reminder: leveling calibration workshops and updated referral policy details are in HR. Managers, watch your inbox for invites.

recording-bot: Reminder: all-hands Mon 9:00am PT. Recording + transcript auto-upload ~10m after meeting to /company/allhands.

[--- meeting happened ---]

alex (CEO): Thanks all. Recording: https://redwoodin.co/recordings/1801200000. Quick summary: 1) Strategy: prioritize reliability and cost-efficiency; 2) Dedicated: beta invites go out next week (limited slots); 3) Policy: new demo approval + security checklist enforced; 4) Incident: brief outage last week, lessons learned; 5) People: leveling workshops scheduled.

maya (VP Product): Dedicated beta notes: pilot onboarding playbook will be posted Mon. If you're onboarding customers, review the checklist and share feedback.

sasha (Security): Security takeaways: demo checklist requires review for any data-containing output. We're introducing a short approval tag in the demo repo (label: security-reviewed).

rachel (Legal): Approval flow: submit draft to #marketing-press, Legal will respond within 48 hours for standard demos. For customer data demos expect longer review.

nina (CTO): Incident recap: root cause was a config rollback that bypassed a canary check. Fixes: revert automation changed, add a pre-rollout gate, and add better alerting. Postmortem link: https://incidents.redwood/2026-07-config-rollback.

sam (People Ops): Q&A highlights: leveling calibration does not change past comp; referral bump effective Aug 1 for qualifying hires.

jen (Marketing): Action: I'll publish an internal launch checklist and embargo playbook in #announcements. Don't share screenshots externally until we post the playbook.

alex (CEO): Action items: 1) Product: publish beta playbook and onboarding checklist by Mon. 2) Security/Legal: finalize demo approval workflow and checklist automation by Wed. 3) Eng: implement pre-rollout gate and update runbooks. Consolidated follow-up doc will be posted to Notion by EOD Tue. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
